description:
Activate Rainveil Rejuvenator by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Rainveil Rejuvenator.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Rainveil Rejuvenator.
Repeat.
